title: Verification snapshot runner
responsibility: Runs exact exported source checks with bounded capture and original-repository reviewer requirements.

inputs.name: SnapshotRunService.constructor.run
inputs.description: Repository root, parsed verification config, and run context for exporting one commit and running checks in isolation. The context excludes the snapshot directory, which this service creates; the config supplies setup, links, declared outputs, builds, tools, runners, checks, and test timeout.

inputs.name: SnapshotRunService.execute.plan
inputs.description: Ordered checks to run after setup and declared-tool version collection succeed. Each check runs in sequence inside the commit snapshot with its planned command and timeout; no checks run if outputs cover tracked files or setup/tool collection fails.

inputs.name: SnapshotRunService.execute.artifactPaths
inputs.description: Snapshot-relative file paths to hash and size after setup and checks. Only files readable inside the snapshot are included; missing paths and paths resolving outside the snapshot are omitted, and the default is [].

inputs.name: snapshotVideoFlags.root
inputs.description: Original repository with durable Git evidence; clean source exports must not be used as evidence roots.

inputs.name: snapshotVideoFlags.scenarios
inputs.description: Exact source-revision scenarios; unenrolled scenarios require no reviewer branch or LFS reads.

inputs.name: pendingVideoEnvironment.env
inputs.description: Existing check environment; only HARNESS_PENDING_VIDEO_FLAGS is authoritatively supplied for enrolled scenarios.

inputs.name: pendingVideoEnvironment.requirements
inputs.description: Known owning flag identities and unresolved ID/note requirements read from original Git evidence; absence proves no supplied flag identities.

inputs.name: snapshotVideoInputs.root
inputs.description: Clean exact-source directory hashed before setup writes; reviewer evidence comes separately from evidenceRoot.

inputs.name: snapshotVideoInputs.scenarios
inputs.description: Exact source-revision scenarios; unenrolled scenarios require no reviewer branch or LFS reads.

inputs.name: snapshotVideoInputs.evidenceRoot
inputs.description: Original Git repository carrying reviewer evidence. Omission uses root, appropriate only when root itself is the repository.

inputs.name: snapshotVideoRun.run
inputs.description: Original repository, clean-export context, declared scenario inputs and ordinary snapshot runner configuration.

inputs.name: snapshotVideoRun.snapshot
inputs.description: Clean exact-source export or its adapter; it contains no repository evidence authority.

inputs.name: snapshotVideoRun.limits
inputs.description: The run existing byte limits, shared by all checks and captures.

inputs.name: snapshotDriftObserver.snapshot
inputs.description: Clean exact-source export or its adapter; it contains no repository evidence authority.

inputs.name: snapshotDriftObserver.seen
inputs.description: Mutable sets accumulating every observed tracked mutation and undeclared output across setup and checks.

outputs.name: SnapshotRunService.execute
outputs.description: The resolved report contains check outcomes, sorted tracked-file mutations and added paths, setup/tool failures, readable requested artifacts, and build failures. It includes build identities only when the config declares builds, and artifact entries contain byte length and SHA-256.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An uncaught Error from snapshot creation, linking, drift checks, check/tool execution, build identity work, or snapshot removal rejects the execution promise. Output misdeclarations, setup/check failures, unavailable tool versions, and build failures are reported in Executed when the delegated services return them as results.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Current reviewer evidence is corrupt, exceeds finite capture-environment bounds, or the replacement omits, misowns or predates a required flag.
